title: 第009章 齐家谋划第010章 你们都得死
content_zh:
什么？
山洞外，众人凝神，谁也没想到竟是有少年突然这般开口。
闻言，叶炎神色一凝。
他本就是要进入这山洞之内，如今更是骤然一步踏出，直接踏入山洞之中。
“炎儿……”
叶龙顿时开口道。
只可惜一切皆是晚了！
“大长老放心，我们会保护炎弟。”叶然、叶童等看到叶炎也是进入山洞，顿时向着叶龙开口道。
叶龙、叶虎叹出一口气，眼中有着担忧之色。
即便是三长老神色也随之一凝，他总觉得事情有些不对劲。
“哈哈哈……”
而这时，齐刀则是大笑起来。
“叶龙，我们来打个赌如何？就赌你叶家的这些人能不能走出剑冢地，我赌你叶家绝对走不出一人。”齐刀喝道。
“你说什么？”叶龙神色一凝。
“你也不用如此，我也只是说说而已。”齐刀阴冷一笑。
齐家之内，众人嘴角处都噙着一抹笑意。
甚至齐长剑也是开口：“剑冢地内，谁知会遇到什么？或许有野兽也说不定，啧啧……叶家如此孱弱，到时候面对着野兽怕是抗衡不了吧？”
闻言，叶龙冷嗤一声：“即便你齐家有狼子野心，但我叶家小辈也不是吃素的。”
“哈哈，我倒是觉得齐家主说的对，里面一切……可都是凶吉难料啊！”但就在这时，方家家主方凌开口。
“不好！”

当其话语落下，叶虎神色一转，顿时道。
叶龙以及叶家的其他人也都意识到了。
齐家与方家……竟是联手了。
若真是如此，那对于叶家小辈而言，当真是致命的打击。
“炎儿……”
叶龙一个箭步冲出直接向着那山洞而去。
嗡！
但在其刚刚踏入山洞门口之时，那山洞上的三个大字‘剑冢地’上顿时释放出一道剑光，让叶龙都难以抗衡只能退后。
“十八岁以上者，果然不得踏入！”
“这可是当初灵台境强者留下的古字，除非是踏入灵台境，不然无法进入。”
四周不少人喃喃道。
这一刻，他们看向叶家的众位长老等人脸上也带着唏嘘之色。
叶龙大怒，而后看向齐刀、方凌等人：“若我叶家弟子死在其内，尔等……也别想好过，即便是拼了这条老命，我也要将你们彻底斩杀！”
轰！
叶虎等人体内也释放出一股气息。
叶家儿郎，同进退、共生死。
“怎么？叶家是想反了天不成，还是不将我与城主府的人放在眼里？”这时，那位花婆婆顿时吼出一声。
这声音落下，震动四方。
“六重洞灵境……”
谁也没想到，这花婆婆竟是如此高深的境界。

至于那城主府的管事，体内也释放出一道气息，同样也是六重洞灵境。
此地出现两位不逊色于叶龙的修炼者，直接在力量上镇压住了叶家人。
“叶家，要倒大霉了！”
content_en:
What?
Outside the cave, everyone was attentive. No one expected that a young man would suddenly speak like this.
Hearing this, Ye Yan's expression condensed.
He originally wanted to enter the cave, but now he suddenly stepped out and stepped directly into the cave.
"Yan'er..."
Ye Long suddenly spoke.
It's a pity that everything is too late!
"Don't worry, Great Elder, we will protect Brother Yan." Ye Ran, Ye Tong and others saw Ye Yan also entering the cave and immediately said to Ye Long.
Ye Long and Ye Hu sighed, with worries in their eyes.
Even the third elder's expression condensed. He always felt that something was wrong.
"Hahaha..."
At this time, Qi Dao laughed.
"Ye Long, how about we make a bet? I bet on whether these people from your Ye family can escape from the Sword Tomb. I bet that no one from your Ye family can escape." Qi Dao shouted.
"What did you say?" Ye Long's expression condensed.
"You don't have to be like this, I'm just talking." Qi Dao smiled coldly.
In the Qi family, everyone had a smile on their lips.
Even Qi Changjian said: "Who knows what we will encounter in the Sword Tomb? Maybe there are wild beasts, tsk tsk... The Ye family is so weak, I'm afraid they won't be able to compete against the wild beasts, right?"
Hearing this, Ye Long sneered coldly: "Even if your Qi family has wolf ambitions, I, the younger generation of the Ye family, am not a vegetarian."
"Haha, I think the head of the Qi family is right. Everything inside... is unpredictable!" But at this moment, the head of the Fang family, Fang Ling, spoke.
"Not good!"
When he finished speaking, Ye Hu's expression changed and he said immediately.
Ye Long and others in the Ye family also realized it.
The Qi family and the Fang family... actually joined forces.
If this is true, it will be a fatal blow to the younger generation of the Ye family.
"Yan'er..."
Ye Long rushed out and headed directly towards the cave.
Buzz!
But when he just stepped into the entrance of the cave, the three big characters "Sword Tomb Land" on the cave suddenly released a sword light, which made Ye Long unable to resist and could only retreat.
"No one over the age of eighteen is allowed to enter!"
"These are the ancient characters left by the strong men of the Lingtai Realm. Unless you step into the Lingtai Realm, you cannot enter."
Many people around murmured.
At this moment, they looked at the elders and others of the Ye family with expressions of sadness on their faces.
Ye Long was furious, and then looked at Qi Dao, Fang Ling and others: "If my disciples of the Ye family die in it, you... don't even think about it. Even if you risk your life, I will kill you completely!"
Boom!
Ye Hu and others also released an aura from their bodies.
The sons and daughters of the Ye family advance and retreat together, live and die together.
"What? Are the Ye family trying to rebel, or do they not take me and the people in the City Lord's Mansion seriously?" At this time, Granny Hua suddenly roared.
The sound fell and shook all directions.
"Sixth Layer Cave Spiritual Realm..."
No one expected that Granny Hua was so advanced.
As for the steward of the City Lord's Mansion, he also released an aura from his body, which was also at the sixth level of cave spirit realm.
Two cultivators who were not inferior to Ye Long appeared here and directly suppressed the Ye family in terms of strength.
"The Ye family is in big trouble!"
